figurative_meaning_en: Nothing at all; a trick or deception
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে এই খেলাটা সম্পর্কে জানে ছাতু।
তার কথায় কোনো ফাঁকি নেই, সব ছাতু।
example_sentences_in_english: He knows nothing about this game.
There's no trick in his words; it's all nothing.
note: Often used in the phrase 'জানে ছাতু' to imply complete ignorance.
